title: No dead ends for the learner
statement: No state, such as a reload mid-step, a failed 3D or media part, or help that has run out, may leave a learner without a way on.
example: A word-web row whose give-after-two-misses had run out of words is released rather than left with nothing to add.
detail: In a 3D version of the Grade 9 lessons, a reload between a lesson's last task and its return to the learning question once left a dead screen; the closing step now counts the task done once its final answer is saved, and finishes a step a reload left between the last reply and the save (`othello-archive/src/steps/Close.tsx`, lines 74-75 and 198). Its reading page sends the learner on when a stage fails, its unit film falls back to a still picture when the 3D fails, and a word-web row that has run out of words to give is released instead of stalling (`othello-archive/src/steps/Reading.tsx`, line 19; `othello-archive/src/film/Film.tsx`, line 135; `othello-archive/src/retrieval/Recall.tsx`, line 173).
